name: Ataka Mao
source:
Teru's childhood friend.

A raven-haired girl with piercing eyes and a fierce look.
She's your classic justice warrior - hates lies, stands up for the underdog, can't stand any funny business, and isn't afraid to call it as she sees it.

In any everyday world, she'd be the oddball everyone avoids, but somehow, she becomes the lovable class weirdo.
Of course, plenty can't stand her "holier-than-thou" attitude. Teru, in particular, represents these individuals, making those two mix like oil and water.

"I knew you were a piece of work, but this is a new low! You man-whore! Absolute trash!"

[Translated from [url=http://clockup.net/dd/character.html]the offical site[/url]]
